camel_example: aliyun ice CreateSearchLib --region cn-hangzhou --SearchLibName test1 --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a search library to manage media assets involved in searches. You can associate self-registered face libraries through search library configurations
description_zh: 创建搜索库，用于管理参与搜索的媒资。支持通过搜索库配置关联自注册人脸库
name: CreateSearchLib

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library. It must be a combination of digits and letters. For IP camera (IPC) scenarios, the prefix must be "IPCamera_". For other scenarios, you can customize the name
parameters.help_zh: 搜索库名称。数字字母组合。网络监控摄像头IPC场景前缀必须为"IPCamera_"，其他自定义即可
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the search library. The value is a JSON string that contains the following field:
faceGroupIds: the IDs of self-registered face libraries. The face libraries are created by calling CreateRecognitionLib. You can specify up to three self-registered face libraries. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
搜索库配置。JSON string格式。其中字段
faceGroupIds ：自注册人脸库ID，来着CreateRecognitionLib创建，最多支持3个自注册人脸库根据英文","拼接
parameters.name: search_lib_config

SearchLibName.description_en: The name of the search library

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
